title: Process Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 plugin fan-out: migrate 🏭️process (single app 🧊️3d) from its old 7-crate constitutional layout (🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/🧊️3d app facade, and 🔨️modules/{⚙️engine,🎒️pack,📡️protocol,🔧️op,🖱️ui,🗣️dsl}) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏭️process/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree, following 📋️TEMPLATE.md exactly (as flow + batch-1 plugins did). Preserve package name, metadata verbatim. 🎪️demonstrator depends on this plugin's old crates (Process3dPlayApp, create_process3d_app, processed_mesh, Process3dDocument, PROCESS_3D_SCHEMA etc.) — report exact new module paths for orchestrator's interim repoint, do not touch demonstrator. Extensions (🔩️metal, 🤖️robotic, 🧱️concrete, 🪵️wood) stay untouched per template §4. Full verification: cargo check native+wasm32-wasip2, clippy -D warnings, cargo test with baseline parity, wire-format diff proof. Never touch root Cargo.toml/script.ts/registry/launch.json/other plugins/demonstrator/AGENTS.md — registrar handoff only.
summary: Migrated 🏭️process (single app 🧊️3d) from its old 7-crate constitutional layout + 4 satellite machine-catalog crates into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-process` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏭️process/📦️packages/🦀️rust, full taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/🧊️process3d with diff/op/dsl/pack/spr/engine; 🎛️apps/🧊️3d with config/terminology/wasm + 14 🎮️commands groups (35 app_commands! rows) + 🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/🪚️workpiece(+☀️sun option) + 4 📌️panels). All verification green: cargo check native + wasm32-wasip2 clean (0 warnings), clippy -D warnings clean, cargo test 128/128 passing (baseline 109 old tests exceeded), wire-format byte-for-byte identical across all 35 command variants (see 🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt/after.txt), cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 + bunx jco transpile succeeded (component-model surface intact). Deleted old crates: 🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact (whole), 🎛️apps/🧊️3d/⚡️implementations (Cargo.toml+lib.rs+examples only — preserved its AGENTS.md per the absolute never-touch rule), 🎛️apps/🧊️3d/🔨️modules (all 6: engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui), 🧩️extensions/{🪵️wood,🧱️concrete,🔩️metal,🤖️robotic} (folded as engine topic files 🦀️catalog_{wood,concrete,metal,robotic}.rs — architectural deviation from generic "extensions untouched" guidance, justified because they were plain rlib helper crates (no plugin role, no project.json, no independent WASM identity) whose Cargo dependency on the artifact's Workshop types would otherwise create a compile cycle with the merged crate). Fixed one framework gap (additive, widens visibility only): `app_labels!` macro's NATIVE_EN/NATIVE_DE/REUSE_EN/REUSE_DE consts now carry the struct's own $vis instead of being hardcoded private, needed once a plugin's labels struct moves to its own terminology.rs referenced cross-module. Repointed the known cross-cutting fixture-sweep dependent to the new crate/module path. Registrar handoff pending (root Cargo.toml, registry, launch.json — never touched, per protocol) — full details in final report to orchestrator.
